annotatedSteps.studentWork: (a) Photosynthesis – the process by which green plants make carbohydrates (glucose) from carbon dioxide and water in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correctly named and defined photosynthesis with key raw materials and conditions.

annotatedSteps.description: Writing the balanced chemical equation for photosynthesis
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
(b) 6CO2 + 12H2O ⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯→ C6H12O6 + 6O2 + 6H2O
(with sunlight, chlorophyll over the arrow)
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correct balanced equation with sunlight and chlorophyll properly indicated.

annotatedSteps.description: Reason and effect of cloudy weather on photosynthesis rate
annotatedSteps.studentWork: (c)(ii) (I) In cloudy weather less sunlight is available, so the rate of photosynthesis decreases.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correct effect (decrease in rate) and valid reason (less sunlight available).

annotatedSteps.description: Reason and effect of dust-blocked stomata on photosynthesis rate
annotatedSteps.studentWork: (II) If stomata get blocked by dust, exchange of gases (CO2 intake) is reduced, so the rate of photosynthesis decreases.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correct effect (decrease in rate) and valid reason (reduced exchange of gases / CO2 intake).

teacherNote: Flawless response. The definitions, chemical equation, and scientific reasoning for both environmental scenarios are precise and complete according to the NCERT textbook.
